page.layout: One page of running text, with the running head centred at the top. Below the last line, the signature "C 3" stands at the left and the catchword "In-" at the right. No marginal notes. The left strip of the scan shows the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: amœnitatum habturæ[?] sint, quanto nos propius ad specialium contemplationem duxerint: magis enim, ut, notum in speciebus, quàm generibus, varia & amœna est Natura. Fateor equidem a doctis non- nullis, ipsoq; Aristotele (quem tamen in multis se- quor) quàm[?] doq; me dissentire, & forsan deinceps dissensuram: attamen, quod sanctè affirmo, nullâ contradicendi carpendique, ne dum alterius fa- ma aut existimationis lædendæ libidine: sed solius veritatis amore: quem qui vitio mihi vertit, veri- tatis hostem judico. Itaq; stylum ubiq; ita tempera-ui, ut vel duriore verbulo adversarium offendere religioni mihi duxerim: quâ moderatione & deinceps me usurum hèic publicè promitto. Detestor calumniatores & nominum alienorum rosores. Ita vero & mecum agi velim. Crudelis erit, quisquis hanc moderationis & humanitatis clavam mihi extorse- rit. Facessant ex liberalium ingeniorum censu ἀρτοπώλιδες: cum bonis bene & comiter agatur.

p.i: Hac scire te volui, benevole Lector, non docere tantùm, sed & discere paratus ab eo, cui docere, non exagitare animus est. B. V.

page.notes: Below the text is a printer's ornament (a small fleuron with a stylised figure), not transcribed. The Greek word "ἀρτοπώλιδες" is copied as read from a small scan and may carry a slightly different accent or breathing. "habturæ" may be "habiturae" with the i missing in print, marked [?]. "quàm doq;" is doubtful and marked [?]. The page carries a faint show-through of the reverse page in the lower half, which is not transcribed.
